reviews.review:
Hello to those that read!
This Game is a Great Co-op Experience. To those that enjoy a challenge with progression. I enjoyed this game to great lengths! It has good combat and a fun build-up! As you move forward you unlock new items to conquer Super Earths Enemies! From Ship upgrades, to Weapons, Down to the Gear you wear. This was an over all enjoyable experience! 
**I will Recommend to those whom haven't joined to experience it for themselves!**

    Revised from Astrics * 
    There is no new equipment. Warbond weapons are becoming fewer. Sure they just added weapon customization but even that is lacking. As for the Illuminate Race, Their plot line needs too be cut short and just destroy Super Earth. They make no sense. As for Bot/AI spawns they have been over bearing at lower levels, Feels like im running a Level 8 Mission at level 1. (I Tested it 388 Kills at Lvl 1!? This is a first, And on top of that the new Jug Lookin thing had 5 in a group? No Longer Enjoying this experience. There is a lack of vision and growth on the player end, 
    *Now, For my portion. Though this game has some form of balance. The weapons get Nerfed, and the content becomes limited and boring. You run a similar path to complete the same objectives. After you've run the same mission for the 100th time it gets old. 
    As for the Weapons and Armor, They become very limited. You have a select amount to utilize for gear upgrades but they come in different styles with no varying difference's between them beyond Light/Medium/Heavy. 
    Weapons are pretty much capped. I've had the same amount of weapons and the states all site at light armor pen. If you happen to get a Weapon at Medium Pen it gets nerfed because someone complained it was to easy on a Level 3 Mission When they rank at Level 80. There is no new weapons in this war. if there is you get 2 that are overpowered for all of a weeks then they nerf it to where i may as well not wasted our(*) money or time on it. (for those that don't grind for super creds) In a war weapon development is key to victory yet we se little to no capable weapons to fight with.
    The Helmets do nothing but give a style to your Helldiver, No buffs, no differences in stat's and you are stuck with a limited color scheme that usually doesn't mesh with other equipment. Capes? Those are the pride of a Helldiver so those do not need to change. 
    I've Seen New Enemy Variants faster than weapons. It gets old and boring. No new map Layouts, they are pretty repetitive, no new ship armaments, no new mission types*

SO FIRE
I LOVE THIS GAME SM
